description.zh: 把踩点工程导出为 A Dance of Fire and Ice (.adofai) 关卡：伪双押/多押、快速跑动、发卡处理、Pause 补偿、近整拍吸附，并可生成装饰泳道（菱形/行星/小节线/播放头）与多轨预览。
description.en: Export the project as a Dance of Fire and Ice (.adofai) level: pseudo double/multi press, rapid runs, hairpins, pause compensation, beat snapping, decoration lanes (dots/planets/bar lines/playhead) and a multi-track preview.
